hearings.committee: Joint Committee on Racial Equity, Civil Rights, and Inclusion
hearings.title:
Legislative Briefing: Racial Wealth Gap Findings
The Joint Committee on Racial Equity, Civil Rights, and Inclusion, in partnership with the Federal Reserve Bank of Boston and The Boston Foundation, will convene an informational briefing on the racial wealth gap in Massachusetts. The briefing will provide legislators, staff, and stakeholders with an overview of the historical and systemic factors contributing to racial disparities in wealth accumulation, including homeownership, income, education, access to capital, and intergenerational wealth. The briefing will provide an opportunity to discuss the Committee's findings and the findings of the recent report on the racial wealth gap, highlighting persistent disparities in wealth accumulation, homeownership, access to capital, and economic opportunity across racial and ethnic communities.

Drawing on research and data from the Federal Reserve Bank of Boston and The Boston Foundation, the discussion will examine persistent economic inequities across the Commonwealth and explore opportunities for public policy to advance racial equity, expand economic mobility, and build generational wealth.

Briefing Objectives
•	Present research and data on racial wealth disparities in Massachusetts, particularly Greater Boston.

•	Examine structural barriers to homeownership, wealth accumulation, and economic opportunity.

•	Highlight the long-term impacts of historical discrimination and systemic inequities.

•	Inform legislative discussions on strategies to close the racial wealth gap and promote economic inclusion.
